## About 4WHEELS Rent a Car
4WHEELS Rent a Car is an established premium vehicle rental and chauffeur service provider based in Johar Town, Lahore, Pakistan. The business provides self-drive rentals, chauffeur-driven executive cars, daily rentals, monthly long-term vehicle arrangements, airport transfers for Allama Iqbal International Airport (LHE), wedding motorcades, corporate staff transportation, and group tour buses.

### Investor Relations & Car Attachment Program
- Attach Your Car Portal: https://www.4wheelspk.com/attach-your-car/
- Program Overview: Local car owners and Overseas Pakistanis (in UAE, UK, Saudi Arabia, USA, Canada, Qatar, Oman, Australia, Kuwait, and Europe) can attach 2018–2026 vehicles to the 4WHEELS fleet to earn PKR 60,000 to PKR 350,000+ monthly passive income.
- Key Security Guarantees: 24/7 global mobile app tracker surveillance, verified corporate/executive clients only, comprehensive maintenance supervision, legal notarized lease agreement, and monthly payouts deposited directly into Roshan Digital Accounts (RDA) or Pakistani bank accounts.
